objective: Audit the pinned StarEmbed ZTF_40k source splits and test whether the frozen v0.2.0 42-feature input path can process a deterministic clean subset without training or predicting.
previous_knowledge_consumed: Issue #210 and PR #211 recorded one duplicate SourceID within the StarEmbed train split and one train/test SourceID overlap; source lineage and split-generation semantics remain unresolved.
StarEmbed has a seven-class taxonomy and is not mapped to the frozen 15-class v0.2.0 production taxonomy.
The experiment is input compatibility only. It must not report model accuracy or alter the v0.2.0 model, features, class order, benchmark, or acceptance criteria.

The first source-backed workflow acquired all five Parquet files and detected one duplicate train SourceID and one train/test overlap. The first attempt did not run the feature probe because GitHub Actions bash inherited errexit.
The public StarEmbed repository documents a class-stratified row-level split script. It does not deduplicate or group by SourceID. Its relation to the exact 2026-05 dataset build remains unverified.

baseline.model: Frozen v0.2.0 feature extractor only; no model inference

sample.policy: exclude duplicated test IDs and IDs overlapping any other split

change.completed: The source-audit workflow now captures both diagnostic return codes, runs the clean-test feature probe even when the global source audit fails, uploads both reports, and enforces the original fail-closed gate after evidence upload.
change.scope: Research branch only: dedicated workflow and this lifecycle record. No production or frozen baseline changes.
change.rationale: The source audit must not prevent collection of independent diagnostic evidence. The final benchmark gate must still reject any duplicate or cross-split object identity.

expected_improvement: Retain exact hashes and row counts for all five pinned Parquet artifacts.
Report duplicate IDs and cross-split overlaps without weakening fail-closed behavior.
Run the deterministic 50-object feature-input probe on unique test IDs that do not overlap any other split.
Upload source audit and feature probe outputs even when the global source-integrity gate fails.
Keep all StarEmbed classifier-performance claims out of scope.

correctness.before: The source audit returned exit code 2 and GitHub Actions bash stopped before the feature-input probe. The final gate received empty output values.
correctness.after: Workflow run 43972197924 executed both diagnostics, captured exit code 2 for each, uploaded both reports, and failed at the final gate as designed.

reproducibility.before: The first run had an acquired source manifest and identity report, but no feature-probe output.
reproducibility.after: The second run used the same source version, five pinned file hashes, sample size 50 and seed 20261115. It produced a 50-row feature Parquet artifact and a machine-readable probe report.

scientific_validity.reason: This experiment verifies feature-input compatibility only. It does not validate classifier performance, taxonomy compatibility, source split integrity, or independent scientific validity.

measurement.trade_off: The workflow runs a diagnostic feature probe on a clean test subset even when the overall source split is blocked. It still fails the final gate while any global duplicate or cross-split overlap remains.

evidence: Source-backed workflow run 43972197924 completed. Focused tests passed: 10 passed in 1.60 seconds.

Train has 29047 rows and 29046 unique SourceIDs. Duplicate SourceID CSS_J164349.2+401208 occurs at combined-train row positions 16033 and 21298. Both rows have identical metadata and identical g/r/i array hashes.
Train/test overlap count is 1. CSS_J051729.2+083846 has identical metadata and identical g/r array hashes in both splits.
Validation has 4150 unique SourceIDs, test has 8301 unique SourceIDs, and anomaly split has 1087 unique SourceIDs.
The identity audit generated a deterministic 50-object test sample with seed 20261115.

The feature probe report states status BLOCKED_SOURCE_SPLIT_INTEGRITY, feature_path_status EXECUTED, selected_clean_test_objects 50, feature_vectors_generated 50, feature_vector_width 42, and zero per-object failures.
Both diagnostics returned exit code 2. The final workflow gate failed with these recorded codes. This is the expected fail-closed result while global split leakage remains.
validation.blocker: The duplicate train SourceID and train/test overlap remain unexplained. The input feature path is verified for this deterministic sample, but StarEmbed benchmark acceptance remains blocked.

root_causes: The source dataset contains one duplicate train SourceID: CSS_J164349.2+401208. Both copies have identical g/r/i array hashes and metadata.
The source dataset contains one SourceID shared by train and test: CSS_J051729.2+083846. Both copies have identical g/r array hashes and metadata.

The first workflow attempt inherited GitHub Actions bash errexit. The source audit returned 2 and prevented the feature probe from running. The workflow fix now captures both return codes and runs both diagnostics.
hypotheses: The upstream StarEmbed build_split.py at commit b76a83af49af29c7042e436b950fc1fd360fa7bd (2025-10-07) flattens metadata and performs class-stratified row-level train_test_split operations with seed 42. The script does not deduplicate or group by SourceID. The companion ZTF README identifies it as the split builder.

This upstream method is consistent with the observed duplicate row and cross-split leakage. However, the exact 2026-05 published dataset snapshot has not yet been tied to this exact script revision and input dataset. Treat this as an unverified root-cause hypothesis.
unresolved: The source-generation reason for the duplicate train SourceID is unknown.
The source-generation reason for the train/test overlap is unknown.
The exact build script and pre-split source snapshot used for the published 2026-05 Parquet files are not yet pinned.
limitations: A successful feature-input probe does not establish classifier accuracy, taxonomy compatibility or independent scientific validation.
The 50-object sample is diagnostic and cannot establish population-level performance.
No production model inference or training is in scope.

findings: The pinned source package is downloadable and all five file hashes are recorded.
The source audit found one duplicate train SourceID and one train/test SourceID overlap.
The implicated duplicate rows have identical per-band array hashes and metadata.
The deterministic clean test sample contains 50 objects and uses seed 20261115.
The frozen v0.2.0 feature path generated all 50 feature vectors with width 42 and zero per-object failures.
The feature probe reports global split leakage and remains blocked while any duplicate or overlap exists.
The upstream class-stratified row-split script is evidence for a hypothesis, not proof of the published dataset's exact build lineage.
